title: State project registration cross-check
question: Which state projects independently identify these contracts?
finding: 105 state registrations support 103 project identities. Multiple state records for one project remain separate rows.
how: Checked state project or contract numbers against the City IDs and the agency bid records; rejected same-number records for other scopes or earlier solicitations. State URLs open the filtered project-number search.
limits: The four retained State project searches contain registration metadata. The separate contractor roster retained for Potrero Yard covers a project outside these 108 sheets. DIR explains that some subcontractors join a registration after filing. State confirmation here concerns project identity only.
